title: Tanzanian Coffee: From Kilimanjaro Slopes to Your Cup
excerpt: Coffee grows on the slopes of Kilimanjaro, Meru and in the southern highlands. What makes Tanzanian coffee special.
body:
## Where it grows

- On the slopes of Kilimanjaro and Meru.
- Around Karatu.
- In the southern highlands (Mbeya, Mbinga).
- Robusta in the northwest near Lake Victoria.

## Arabica and peaberry

Most of Tanzania's high-altitude coffee is arabica. Tanzanian peaberry beans, a single round bean instead of two, are well known.

## Taste

Often bright and fruity with good acidity.

## Smallholders

Much coffee is grown by small farmers, often in cooperatives.

## Visit

A [coffee tour in Materuni](/blog/materuni-waterfall-coffee-tour/) or near Karatu.

## Buy

Buy beans from local roasters or cooperatives.
